title: Data Lake, Lakehouse & BigLake — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Multi-Cloud BigLake Federated Query Flow: analyst submits single SQL join -> BigQuery Omni runs local compute in AWS S3 -> joins with GCP Iceberg -> streams unified result.
routing_rationale: BigQuery Omni executes compute natively within AWS and Azure facilities, sending only the final aggregated result rows across cloud boundaries.

nodes.label: Federated Multi-Cloud SQL
nodes.detail: Analyst writes standard SQL joining AWS order logs with GCP customer records.

nodes.label: BigQuery Omni (AWS us-east-1)
nodes.detail: Reads 10TB of S3 Parquet data locally; filters down to 50KB summary result.

nodes.label: Compact 50KB Cross-Cloud Egress
nodes.detail: Transfers only the 50KB aggregated summary from AWS to GCP over TLS.

nodes.label: Unified Analytical View
nodes.detail: Final joined dataset delivered to dashboard with zero multi-terabyte egress charges.

steps.title: In-Region Compute Execution
steps.action: BigQuery Omni runs compute inside AWS, reducing 10TB of raw files to 50KB.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates AWS internet data egress charges ($900 saved on single query).

steps.title: Seamless Cross-Cloud Join
steps.action: BigQuery joins compact AWS summary with GCP customer data in memory.
steps.why_traversal: Enables multi-cloud analytics without complex ETL pipelines.

scenarios.label: AWS IAM Role Expiration Drops Query
scenarios.root_cause: The AWS IAM role assumed by Google Cloud STS expired after 12 hours.
scenarios.recovery: Configure automated AWS IAM role trust policy renewal with Google Cloud identity federation.
